name: @w6w-apps/murf
description: Generate speech with Murf: Gen2 text-to-speech, voice library, cloned voices, voice changer, text translation and Murf Dub dubbing jobs and projects.

w6w.longDescription:
Murf is an AI voice platform. This app synthesizes speech from text with the Gen2 model (voice, locale, style, speed, pitch, pronunciation dictionary, output format, optional zero-retention Base64 audio), browses the voice library with locale, gender and style filters, lists, checks and deletes cloned voices, converts an audio file at a URL into another voice with the Voice Changer, and translates text between languages.

It also drives the Murf Dub automation API: list the source and destination dubbing languages, create transient dubbing jobs or project-based jobs from a file URL, poll a job for its download links, and create, list and update dubbing projects. Murf Dub uses a separate API key from the speech API, so the connection takes both.

Health checks track Murf's own status page (the API component) and whether api.murf.ai is serving.
